why: Nguyen, Scott and Seymour's 'Induced subgraph density VII: the five-vertex path' proves the Erdos-Hajnal conjecture for the five-vertex path H=P5, completing verification for all five-vertex graphs H; follow-up work (arXiv 2606.06258) extends this to two six-vertex graphs (the E-graph and Bird graph). These are cases of the stated conjecture (specific forbidden induced subgraph H) settled, with continuing activity into 2025-2026.
